span.p:
t=0: Cache.set(article:999,
"Version A", ttl=300)
t=10: DB updated to "Version
B"
t=10..300: All reads get
"Version A" from cache
t=300: Cache expires, readers
finally see "Version B"
Staleness = 290 seconds.
Unacceptable.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 110px; text-align: center; width: 110px;

span.p:
t=299: 99,000 cache entries
all expire within 1s
t=300: 99,000 requests hit DB
simultaneously
DB connection pool exhausted
(pool=1000)
98,000 requests queue or
timeout
Site becomes unresponsive
